ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Tawbah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawbah.
   B. Use Tawbah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Tawbah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Tawbah has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Islamic Morality? (1 mark)
   A. Use Significance of Islamic Morality to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Islamic Morality.
   C. Say Significance of Islamic Morality has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Significance of Islamic Morality with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 .
   C. Use Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in the Last Day Hellfire.
   B. Say Belief in the Last Day Hellfire has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Belief in the Last Day Hellfire to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Qadar? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Qadar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Qadar.
   C. Use Belief in Qadar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in Qadar has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shariah religion intellect life property dignity.
   B. Use Shariah religion intellect life property dignity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Shariah religion intellect life property dignity has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an.
   D. Use Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Tawbah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Significance of Islamic Morality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam Zina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
